'''Red Hydra pistols''' were [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] that were once favored by [[Officer/Legends|officers]] and [[squad leader]]s in the military forces of the [[Quohag sector/Legends|Quohag sector]]. They were decommissioned by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] order.

Around the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] a small company won the rights to produce a new line of Red Hydra pistols, the [[Red Hydra Z-5]].
